integral.feedback: last delayed/noisy observable position, one additional physical step old; no true parameters
integral.antiwindup: clamped integral; block integration when prior command slew or native force saturates; reset on protective hold

checkpoint_selection: fixed final accepted common budget, no best-seed or best-reward filtering; all final checkpoints evaluated
staging: close and count unfinished episode at2048 for all groups; resume weights/optimizer/RNG on a fresh environment at common episode offset; no hidden physical steps
evaluation_budget: 3B updates1..3 x nominal/gain two diagnostic replay cases=6 new; integral pilot train/validation x3=6; stage gates validation xgain/mass x4=8; final validation/test x3 x(M1,M3,integral,4PPO)=42
prohibited: no100k training, no unsafe historical narrow path exploration, no changes to old sources or results, no parameter oracle
